skill.summary: Create targeted B2B videos showcasing training impact, methodology, ROI, and expert credibility to attract and convert enterprise clients in corporate learning.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the C-Suite Coach Video Marketing skill.

- Provides targeted video content strategies for c-suite coach companies, L&D consultants, online course creators, and corporate training providers.
- Includes detailed video type breakdowns: program showcases, case studies, methodology explainers, expert intros, demos, industry-specific pieces, and more.
- Offers ready-to-use script templates for client ROI case studies, methodology explainers, and L&D thought leadership.
- Lists practical filming tips to ensure professional B2B video standards.
- Focuses on addressing key buyer concerns: demonstrated outcomes, industry understanding, credibility, and ROI.
